parameters.query: SELECT d.stage, COUNT(*) as deal_count, SUM(d.deal_value) as total_value, AVG(d.probability) as avg_probability, SUM(d.deal_value * d.probability / 100) as weighted_value FROM deals d WHERE d.stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY CASE d.stage WHEN 'prospecting' THEN 1 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 2 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 3 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 4 END

SELECT COUNT(*) as won_count, COALESCE(SUM(deal_value), 0) as won_value FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won' AND updated_at > date_trunc('month', NOW()); SELECT COUNT(*) as lost_count, COALESCE(SUM(deal_value), 0) as lost_value FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_lost' AND updated_at > date_trunc('month', NOW()); SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (updated_at - created_at))) as avg_cycle_days FROM deals WHERE stage = 'closed_won' AND updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days';

SELECT d.assigned_to, COUNT(*) as deal_count, SUM(d.deal_value) as total_value, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_won') as won, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.stage = 'closed_lost') as lost FROM deals d WHERE d.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND d.assigned_to IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.assigned_to ORDER BY total_value DESC
